# 0.1.1-beta.16

Beta.16 refines Shibumi's bar alignment, panels, and V1 widget placement while
retaining the 24-plugin suite and transactional installation model.

## Highlights

- Bar symbols use Omarchy's configured bar font and shared icon size. Ordinary
  bar text shares a font-reference baseline; the smaller date follows the clock.
- The notification bell is an outline with a theme color01 dot for a positive
  count and a ring while unknown or loading.
- Update and tray badges are smaller, with single digits centered and longer
  counts growing to the right.
- CPU and GPU load share a concentric water-ring display. Battery and Temperature
  panels use water rings and compact metrics, with a charging plasma effect in
  the Battery panel. Panel-only animations stop when their panel closes.
- The battery bar symbol can be horizontal or vertical. Its horizontal charging
  bolt uses the theme's color01; in V2, the horizontal battery rests on its
  displayed value's baseline.
- Switching from V1 to V2 without restarting the shell no longer leaves the
  horizontal battery too low.
- Desktop Brightness shows the current output name, or just its monitor symbol
  in icon modes.
- The media panel has compact transport buttons with equally sized, centered
  symbols. Power Profile buttons keep distinct active/hover states, readable
  labels, and the panel's corner radius.
- Feature-panel headings use one uppercase style. AI model-usage bars use the
  accent color, and the widget tooltip explains unavailable provider limits.
- V1 placement reuses eligible empty or switched-off slots before refusing a
  widget, preserves parked fixed-widget identities, and explains when the bar
  is full. Active widgets and capacity limits are unchanged.
- Picker palette dots show the selected theme's colors, bar shadows fade out
  without enlarging input regions, and the active-bar card drops its redundant
  LIVE marker.

## Compatibility

Beta.16 targets the pinned Omarchy and Omarchy Settings `4.0.4-1` package and
Omarchy `v4.0.4` source baselines with Quickshell `0.3.1-1`. It does not update
Omarchy. The published predecessor is `v0.1.1-beta.15.4` (2026-09-28).

## Install and update

### Source checkout

For a new installation, install the runtime dependencies and use the release tag:

```bash
sudo pacman -S --needed python jq curl networkmanager power-profiles-daemon upower xdg-utils libnotify wl-clipboard ttf-material-symbols-variable ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic noto-fonts-cjk adwaita-fonts
git clone https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell.git
cd Shibumi-Shell
git checkout v0.1.1-beta.16
./scripts/shibumi-suite install --yes
```

Update an admitted Beta.15.4 installation from its existing checkout:

```bash
git fetch --tags
git checkout v0.1.1-beta.16
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --dry-run
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
./scripts/shibumi-suite status
```

Beta.16 admits the exact Beta.15.4 tag, release merge, and documentation merge
identities. Older supported predecessors remain subject to exact revision and
payload checks; an arbitrary checkout with the same version is not admitted.
Do not install from `main`. For an unadmitted development installation, follow
[supervised recovery](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16/docs/install.md#supervised-recovery) using the exact
installed code; do not remove lifecycle state to bypass admission.

### Arch package

AUR publication remains deferred. Once separately published and available:

```bash
omarchy pkg aur add shibumi-shell && shibumi-shell install --yes
```

For a package update after the new package is available:

```bash
omarchy update
shibumi-shell update --dry-run
shibumi-shell update --yes
shibumi-shell status
```

`omarchy update` is a separate system update, not a Shibumi-only operation.
Pacman replaces immutable system files; the explicit unprivileged Shibumi
transaction stages and verifies the user's 24 plugins. To adopt a package from
an admitted checkout installation, install the package and run `shibumi-shell
update --yes`, not a second install. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16/docs/install.md).

## Downgrade warning

**Downgrade:** Beta.15.4 and older cannot read V1 layouts with parked widgets
(`order.parked`). They reset the V1 order, roles and splits to defaults; other
settings and V2 stay. `uninstall --keep-settings` does not prevent this. Before
downgrading, back up `~/.config/omarchy/shell.json` and `~/.local/state/shibumi/`.
Details: [Backup before downgrade](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16/docs/install.md#backup-before-downgrade).

## Known limits

- Horizontal Top and Bottom bars remain the supported presentations. Vertical
  layout/clipping is not corrected here; the vertical bar is deferred to V3 in
  `0.2.0-beta`.
- Physical multi-output, mixed-scale, hotplug, suspend/resume, enterprise Wi-Fi,
  and Bluetooth device workflows require their own acceptance. Fixtures and
  software-rendered previews do not establish those results.
- The pinned Omarchy 4.0.x plugin API exposes Recent notification history, not
  Live popups. A dot does not imply new Live-popup access; the existing count
  semantics and app-focus behavior remain.
- The smaller date stays on the clock baseline in Beta.16; raising it again
  is deferred to 0.2.x.
- Validation is revision-bound. See [release readiness](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16/docs/release-readiness.md)
  for the recorded product evidence and separate package and hardware acceptance
  boundaries.
